title: Addon Task Runtime Contract
problem: Nako has manifest-declared Addon Task routing plans and now has a completed host-owned runtime surface for execution, direct task-path dispatch, progress, results, cancellation, retry, and sidecar execution input while splitting source catalog, package signing, provider breadth, process supervision, authenticated outbound task-dispatch credential management, and official-addon task smoke to follow-ons.

evidence.summary: Lane opened after the source catalog and manager lifecycle lanes clarified their own boundaries.
Reference study completed against the existing Addon Task declaration and routing-plan model; bulk-metadata-scrape remains a declaration example, not a runtime contract.

Implemented AddonTaskRun host-owned run model, SQLite/PostgreSQL storage, Admin create/list/get/retry routes, Addon runtime claim/progress/complete/fail/cancel routes, sidecar execution input on lease, and focused HTTP tests.
Implemented direct Addon Sidecar task-path dispatch on the host-owned run model with target-job claiming, task envelopes, direct retry inheritance, and cancellation-aware completion.
Closed the lane after final docs, format, diff, compile, and addon runtime gates; split authenticated outbound task dispatch credential management and official-addon task-path smoke into follow-ons.

continue_policy.notes: The host-owned Addon Task runtime contract is complete. Open separate follow-on lanes for authenticated outbound task-dispatch credential management, official-addon task-path smoke coverage, source catalog / marketplace discovery, package signing, provider breadth, or direct process/container supervision.
